resources.string: Mac / iPhone / iPad: Control Center → Screen Mirroring → TVCompanion. For music, choose TVCompanion in the AirPlay audio picker. YouTube’s in-app AirPlay video is experimental; protected service video may be unsupported. During video, press OK to show controls. Back leaves playback.
Audio can play without video. To share a screen, use Screen Mirroring. If you already shared a screen but the picture is missing, reconnect from your Apple device.
Video has not reached the display yet. If it stays blank, reconnect Screen Mirroring from your Apple device.
Choose Retry playback. If it fails again, reconnect from your Apple device. Back returns to AirPlay settings.
Back leaves playback and ends this session. Background listening can remain on.
Back leaves playback. If connected, the session stays connected; hidden audio is off.
Back leaves playback. If connected, the session and audio can continue in the background.
Listening for Screen Mirroring and audio
AirPlay connected · Open playback or Stop
Sound is unavailable or held by another app. Video can continue; Back leaves playback.
This video requires content protection unavailable in this receiver. Use the service’s supported TV app or receiver. Back leaves playback.
Reconnect video from the sender. The stream may require another format, authorization or supported TV app. Audio and screen mirroring use separate paths.
